title: Query returns unavailable status when active rent exists for requested period
gherkin:
Feature: Availability Query Correctness
  Scenario: Item marked unavailable during active rent period
    Given an item with no restrictions or maintenance periods
    And a rent record in Active status for 2024-01-10 to 2024-01-20
    When I query availability for the item on 2024-01-15
    Then the system returns unavailable status
    And the query reflects the current lifecycle state of the rent record
rationale: Validates core requirement that availability queries reflect current rent status. Tests that active rent records correctly block availability during their period.
usedContextItems: System shall return availability status indicating whether item is available or unavailable for requested period|System shall ensure availability status reflects current lifecycle state of rent records|System shall calculate item availability based on existing rent records
